tasks.subject: F1.2: Trigger, pcvelz phrases, pre-flight, resume
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `SKILL.md`, `references/preflight.md` and `references/resuming.md` point at the new file and make the dependency ruling part of every pre-flight scan.

**Files:**
- Modify: `skills/subagent-driven-development/SKILL.md` (line 289; §Bounded Parallel Dispatch, lines ~411-422; the Setup node of the process graph, lines 75 and 82)
- Modify: `skills/subagent-driven-development/references/preflight.md`
- Modify: `skills/subagent-driven-development/references/resuming.md`
- Create: `tests/parallel-dispatch/test-skill-text.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Line 289's sentence is replaced by the exact trigger sentence below.
- [ ] §Bounded Parallel Dispatch carries the three phrase changes of spec F and quotes the new ban sentence; every other line of it is unchanged (`git diff` shows only those lines).
- [ ] Both occurrences of the Setup node label read `Setup: worktree, ledger check, read plan, pre-flight review and dependency ruling`.
- [ ] `preflight.md` ends with the dependency ruling (spec F §Design item 1) and its ledger form.
- [ ] `resuming.md` has one line pointing at `parallel-dispatch.md` for tasks in flight in nested worktrees.
- [ ] `bash tests/parallel-dispatch/test-skill-text.sh` prints `PASS`, exit 0; the existing tests named in Task F1.1 still pass.

tasks.subject: F1.3: Version bump
